- Choose-Task startup: read previous progress, current_tasks.md, and current_tasks_done.md.
- Active tasks are all non-bug failing tasks at first read; no bug tasks visible.
- Refreshing task summary and checking task files for priority or blocked_by tags before writing current_task.txt.

- Choose-Task selection complete.
- Refreshed task summary and checked current active tasks plus task files for <priority> and <blocked_by>; none were present for active failing tasks.
- No active bug tasks were visible, so bug-first rule did not select anything.
- Selected .ralph/tasks/10-story-observe-reconciliation/01-task-implement-observe-reconciliation.md because it is the foundational remaining reconciliation behavior before Manage, lifecycle, write semantics, testing setup, and final acceptance.
- Created .ralph/current_task.txt with only that path.

- Read prior progress: choose-task selected .ralph/tasks/10-story-observe-reconciliation/01-task-implement-observe-reconciliation.md.
- Read required tdd and improve-code-boundaries skill instructions.
- Current git status already has Ralph-generated changes in .ralph/current_tasks.md, .ralph/current_tasks_done.md, .ralph/current_task.txt, and progress/12.jsonl; these are not mine to revert.
- Next: read selected task and decide whether to plan or execute based on task marker.

- Read selected observe reconciliation task; no TO BE VERIFIED/NOW EXECUTE marker was present, so this is the planning pass.
- Inspected stateoperator manager pipeline and tests. Existing code already has ProcessManagerSnapshot, RemoteGroupFromNSXGroup, ApplyManagerPlan, defaultManagerSweep, observe upserts/deletes/statuses, and typed kube adapter.
- Likely remaining work: verify finalizer on observe-imported CRs, expression parsing coverage for exact empty/IP/IP OR segment/unsupported cases, concrete e2e/manual evidence, and boundary cleanup around observe intent/planned Kubernetes operations if execution reveals duplication.
- Next: write .ralph task plan ending in NOW EXECUTE, update task with plan marker/path, then quit immediately per startup instructions.

- Read improve-code-boundaries smell catalog files 1-14 and how-to-create-found-smell.
- Boundary risks for observe task: manager_pipeline.go may keep too much policy in one file, RemoteGroupFromNSXGroup expression parsing may deserve a clearer parse boundary if IP OR segment support expands, and observe upsert construction currently repeats ObjectMeta/Spec shape in two branches.
- Concrete acceptance gaps noticed from code inspection: observe upserts currently have only ObjectMeta{Name: name} and no finalizer; expression tests do not separately prove empty expression, IP-only expression, or IP OR segment expression behavior.
- Writing plan at .ralph/tasks/10-story-observe-reconciliation/01-task-implement-observe-reconciliation_plans/2026-05-19-observe-reconciliation-plan.md and updating task marker to NOW EXECUTE before quitting.

- Startup read complete: previous progress says observe reconciliation plan was written and task moved to NOW EXECUTE.
- Read tdd and improve-code-boundaries skill entrypoints; now reading current task, plan, and boundary smell files needed for execution.

- Task file contains NOW EXECUTE and points to observe reconciliation plan.
- Read all improve-code-boundaries smell files and the tdd skill; proceeding with vertical red-green slices from the plan.
- First inspection focus: stateoperator manager pipeline/tests, Observe finalizers, remote expression parsing, and existing apply/reconcile evidence.

- TDD slice 1: added failing assertion that remote-only Observe import carries GroupFinalizer; focused test failed with empty finalizers.
- Implemented shared observeGroupFromRemote(name, remote) constructor with GroupFinalizer and reused it for remote-only and existing Observe upserts.
- Focused remote-only import test now passes.

- Added exact RemoteGroupFromNSXGroup tests for empty expression, IP expression, IP OR segment expression, and unsupported expression preserving representable fields.
- Empty and IP tests passed on existing parser; IP OR segment test failed because ConjunctionOperator was always unsupported.
- Added ConjunctionOperator parsing that accepts only conjunction_operator=OR; OR and unsupported preservation tests now pass.

- Added apply-boundary test proving Observe-only upsert/status/delete/cloud-status plan runs with managerClient=nil; it passes.
- Existing Observe deletion reconcile test passes and proves finalizer removal without constructing an NSX manager client.
- Expanded default typed-kube sweep test to prove import finalizer/spec, remote replacement finalizer/spec, stale delete, and no manager DeleteGroup operation; direct go test cannot run it without KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS, so it must be verified through make test/check.
- Ran focused non-envtest stateoperator tests for ProcessManagerSnapshot, RemoteGroupFromNSXGroup, ApplyManagerPlan, and GroupReconcileObserve; they pass.

- Ran gofmt on manager pipeline files and focused non-envtest stateoperator tests again; focused tests pass.
- Updated the task plan checklist for completed TDD slices 1-8.
- Next: run make check, make test, make test-coverage; then do final improve-code-boundaries review and record evidence in task file.

- make check failed during its go test ./... step in TestDefaultManagerSweepAppliesObserveUpsertStatusAndDeleteThroughTypedKubeAPI.
- Failure is useful: typed Kubernetes apply merged old and remote CIDRs for an Observe replacement, producing [10.70.0.0/24 10.71.0.0/24] instead of replacing with [10.71.0.0/24].
- Next: inspect kubeapi Apply/update semantics and fix the apply boundary so Observe mirror spec replacement is actually a replacement.

- Fixed typed kube apply boundary: kubeAPIAdapter.ApplyGroup now create-or-updates the whole NSXGroup spec, preserves existing metadata, and adds desired finalizers instead of server-side applying a set list that merged stale CIDRs.
- Focused non-envtest stateoperator tests pass after the fix.
- Focused envtest sweep test passes with KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS from setup-envtest; it now proves remote-only import, remote spec replacement, stale Observe delete, finalizers, and no NSX DeleteGroup operation.

- Required checks now pass: make check, make test, and make test-coverage.
- make test-coverage reports stateoperator at exactly 80.0% and all packages at 80%+.
- Next: final improve-code-boundaries review, update task evidence and passes flag, run task_switch, add all files, commit, push.

- Final boundary review completed: no new duplicate DTOs, no stringly rendering spread, Observe CR construction centralized in observeGroupFromRemote, kube create-or-update semantics kept at apply boundary.
- Updated task file to status done, passes true, all acceptance criteria checked, and recorded concrete command/e2e evidence.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, then git add all, commit, push, and quit immediately.
